## Getting Started

sqlpipe moves data between databases with one command. It runs on Linux and macOS. Follow these steps to install and run it.

1. Install sqlpipe with this command:
   `curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh`
2. Create a config file named `sqlpipe.yaml` in your project folder. Add your source and target connections to this file.
3. Run sqlpipe with this command:
   `sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml`

sqlpipe reads `sqlpipe.yaml` and starts the pipeline defined in this file. The terminal shows the row count for each table during the run.

If `sqlpipe.yaml` has an error, sqlpipe stops and prints the error message. Fix the error in `sqlpipe.yaml`. Then run the command again.

For the full list of config keys, see the reference guide.
